items.markdown:
On the Gold Coast, confidential off-market prestige sales and high-net-worth buyer networks are dominated by `high-performance boutique and international luxury agencies` that leverage private client databases rather than public portals.[[1]](https://kollosche.com.au/off-market/)[[2]](https://www.preqld.com.au/off-market)[[3]](https://queenslandsothebysrealty.com/)

### Leading Agencies & Specialized Networks

- **[Kollosche](https://kollosche.com.au/)** : Widely recognized as a market leader in Gold Coast luxury real estate, operating a dedicated [Kollosche Off Market Platform](https://kollosche.com.au/media-centre/prestige-property-drivers) that matches high-net-worth buyers with discreet sellers across high-value strips like Mermaid Beach and Sovereign Islands.[[1]](https://kollosche.com.au/)[[2]](https://kollosche.com.au/off-market/)[[3]](https://kollosche.com.au/media-centre/prestige-property-drivers)
- **[Queensland Sotheby's International Realty](https://queenslandsothebysrealty.com/)** : Connects local prestige properties directly to an elite international and domestic database, managing private transactions utilizing global luxury networks.[[1]](https://queenslandsothebysrealty.com/)
- **Ray White Main Beach** : Led by high-profile agents like Michael Willems, this office handles multi-million-dollar beachfront and riverfront portfolios, providing private client advisory and confidential sales.[[1]](https://www.realestate.com.au/agency/ray-white-main-beach-XRWXEW)
- **[Phillis Real Estate Queensland](https://www.preqld.com.au/off-market)** : Specifically markets an exclusive Off-Market Service tailored to ultra-private owners across Sovereign Islands, Sanctuary Cove, and Hope Island who refuse public listing exposure.[[1]](https://www.preqld.com.au/off-market)
- **[Lucy Cole Prestige](https://www.lucycole.com.au/)** : A boutique independent agency operating for over 25 years, specializing in discreet transactions for luxury penthouses and Main River estates.[[1]](https://www.lucycole.com.au/)
- **[JW Prestige Agents](https://prestigeagents.com.au/)** : A specialized high-end agency focused on tailored marketing, private client advisory, and confidential record-breaking transactions across the coastal belt.[[1]](https://prestigeagents.com.au/)

If you can share whether you are **looking to buy or sell** , your **target suburb** (e.g., Mermaid Beach, Main Beach, Sanctuary Cove), and your **approximate price threshold** , I can help narrow down the best specific agent contact for your needs.
